title: Madd muttasil: madd and hamza joined: rule card and examples

source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 22 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Madd muttasil rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 22. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Madd muttasil
points: Madd letter + hamza in the SAME word

head: Not this

rows: Stretching muttasil for 4 counts in one place and 2 in another
Choose 4 or 5 and keep it the same through the recitation

keywords.def: madd letter and hamza in the same word: 4 or 5 counts
the letter ء, a short catch in the throat
the wavy line (ٓ) that shows a longer madd

questions.q: Recite «رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ» (106:2) and count the madd.
questions.a: ٱلشِّتَآءِ: alif then hamza in the same word: muttasil, 4 or 5 counts.

questions.q: Muttasil hunt (pupil PDF): find the madd muttasil in An-Nasr 110:1 to 3 and Quraysh 106:1 to 2. Today's rota group recites 90:8 to 14 to the teacher.
Extend: write one rule sentence: 'Madd muttasil is ...'
questions.a: Madd muttasil is a madd letter followed by a hamza in the same word, stretched 4 or 5 counts.

questions.q: Stretch: find the madd muttasil in Al-Balad 90:18.
questions.a: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ: alif then hamza in the same word.
A) Madd muttasil. Alif then hamza in the same word: madd muttasil, 4 or 5 counts.

questions.q: Think again: Muttasil means 'joined'. What do you think is joined in madd muttasil?
questions.a: The madd letter and the hamza are joined in the same word, so the madd becomes longer.
